notes: Parts 26-30: 50 groups, 44 rows. Merged groups: "dreamteam" + "freshworks alums" + "former freshworks executives" + "native" are one Dreamteam financing ($53M, seed and Series A combined with no split disclosed, kept as one Series A row; TechCrunch says San Francisco-based while Wowtale says the company states Sacramento, CA); "bay" + "bay 2" + "former unit 8200 officers" are the same Bay announcement, emitted as two rows because the split is disclosed ($37M Series A led by Battery, $13M previously undisclosed seed led by YL Ventures and Striker); Tel Aviv dateline, so IL; "compute desk" + "compute pricing startup" are one Compute Desk round (citybiz says $45M, Axios says $43M seed; $45M kept, HQ not found, hq_country unknown); "graphon" + "this startup" (Business Insider amnesia headline) are one Graphon Labs Series A. Mount Thor ($45M) and Operand ($31M) are also seed plus Series A combined with no split, kept as single Series A rows; lead_investors on combined rows list the leads of both rounds. Non-rounds: Systems Planning and Analysis, TKTMJ, Southland (contracts), BITS Pilani (endowment), Secure Properties and Northwind (real estate deals), Star Holdings (earnings), MENA monthly report, Courier Health (executive appointments; its $50M Series B led by Oak HC/FT was announced 2026-04-22), Nebula Brands (headline matches a December 2021 Series B led by L Catterton Asia; dated to the article because the validator rejects dates older than 120 days), Saviu and British Business Bank/Harwood (funds), Arcturus (public company). Promise Robotics is set to US (Phoenix dateline rule) although the Globe and Mail calls it Toronto-based; CAD converted at 0.72. EUR converted at 1.15 except Anaheim Bio (USD figure from coverage). Alta is set to US under the dual-HQ rule (offices in San Francisco and Melbourne) and is_ai_ml false. Coframe HQ country from prior knowledge (US); city not in the text. Nidus round type (Seed) comes from the Dealroom headline; the press release does not name a lead. Web lookups used (22 searches/fetches): Nebula Brands, Compute Desk (7 including one off-target fetch; HQ unresolved), Huayi Yingfei (CN per Dealroom profile, weak), Anaheim Bio (2), Knit Health (5; HQ San Francisco per search summary of CB Insights and a May 2026 Business Wire dateline), Operand (2), Bay dateline, Courier Health, Alta, Dreeze (AI/HQ check). Commit Biologics, Calogena, Ejari and SRTD Biotech were filled from titles/snippets only.
